content.short: Pendle is a foundational yield-trading protocol that allows users to tokenize and trade future yields of DeFi assets.
content.description:
Pendle is a leading decentralized finance protocol that enables the tokenization and trading of future yields, providing participants with unparalleled control over their digital asset returns. The protocol splits yield-bearing tokens—such as stETH or GLP—into two distinct components: Principal Tokens (PT) and Yield Tokens (YT). This innovative model allows users to either lock in a guaranteed fixed yield by holding PT or to speculate on yield fluctuations by trading YT within a specialized AMM.

Operating across major networks including Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Mantle, Pendle has become a cornerstone of the "Yield Tokenization" sector, fostering a more efficient and professional-grade financial landscape. The platform is designed for maximum capital efficiency, enabling sophisticated strategies such as yield hedging and leveraged yield exposure. Through its focus on transparent on-chain execution and deep liquidity, Pendle is empowering the next generation of DeFi participants to manage their financial risk and maximize their returns with institutional-grade precision.
content.meta: Pendle provides decentralized yield tokenization and trading for fixed-yield and speculative yield strategies.
